## CreateUploadOptions.contentType property

The media type the caller says its bytes have: a string of at most 255 UTF-16 code units, the longest media type RFC 6838 allows. A hint only: it is never verified, and consumers may ignore it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly contentType?: string;
```
